_about: Airbus A300 AC (Rev 22, Dec 01/09), 2.2 General Dimensions, Model B2-B4 (page index 28): layers.py --mode image at scale 5, clip 110,520,555,665 (front). Pixels of that raster, line centres; the right half as drawn (the aircraft's left side). The fuselage is a circle of 110 px about (1098, 480); its top sits on one of the grid's lines. The centerline is 1096 px, the middle of the wing tips, the engines and the fin (the circle draws 2 px right of it). The cockpit's side windows are the double arcs inside it. The flap-track fairings hang under the wing's lower line: it's bridged past them (hidden), through points read between them. The inlet is the nacelle's outer ring, placed as free points (the inner ring and the pylon run close by): 102 px across, 104 high, its middle 7.93 m out (the printed 15.87 m apart).
